result.title: Reading Beyond OCR Noise: Robust Cross-Lingual RAG for Legislative Archives
result.summary: India's historical public archives present severe computer vision and document image analysis challenges: decades of parliamentary records survive only as degraded, multi-column scanned pages featuring mixed scripts, complex layouts, and dense visual noise where OCR failure is the primary obstacle to information retrieval. We present an end-to-end framework that couples vision-based layout segmentation and multi-script OCR with an agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline. Our approach specifically addresses how visual degradation and layout fragmentation propagate into text extraction errors, using an iterative agentic loop to navigate around OCR noise and layout ambiguities before generating answers. Evaluated on the 200,000-page Punjab Vidhan Sabha archive, our system demonstrates robust handling of historical document degradation, outperforming standard text-only baselines.

AI.brief_summary: 论文面向印度 degrad 历史议会档案，将视觉版面分割、多脚本 OCR 与带 agentic 迭代循环的 RAG 管线组合，用于绕开 OCR 噪声与版面碎片化后生成答案，并在 20 万页档案上对比纯文本基线。
